description: On the desk in front of you, there’s a small white shelf unit in the back-right corner and several paperback books lying flat nearby. The right hand reaches to the green book on the right, lifts and rotates it upright, then slides it into a slot of the white shelf and releases it; next the right hand picks up the red book, turns it upright, briefly tests it at the shelf opening, pulls it back slightly, and then pushes it in to stand beside the first book, while the left hand stays low and mostly still without holding anything.
